SOM.note: Tender for a grievance platform; no business register stated.

facts.fact: Somalia's Ministry of Finance issued a World Bank-funded request for bids on 12 December 2024 to design, supply and commission a Citizen Engagement and Grievance Redress Mechanism platform, bids due 12 January 2025.
